purpose: Independent practice of D2.2 two-population testing.
student_learning_goal: I can test a prediction by comparing two populations.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can test a prediction by comparing two populations.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon in the top-right with a clover charm and two side-by-side data charts. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 scenarios, predict if Class A and Class B will have the SAME favourite.
parts.visual_layout: Four scenario boxes with same/different choice circles for each population pair.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 prediction layout for two-population worksheet, B&W line art. 4 scenarios: 'favourite sport', 'favourite snack', 'pet at home', 'bedtime'. Each row: SAME / DIFFERENT circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_PREDICT at Part 1: keywords name the population prediction task.

parts.student_instructions: Look at 2 paired data sets. Find each population's favourite.
parts.visual_layout: Two side-by-side columns showing Class A and Class B frequency counts for the same survey question.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 two-column data layout for two-population worksheet, B&W line art. Class A column: hockey 8, soccer 4, basketball 3. Class B column: soccer 6, hockey 5, basketball 4. Below the columns: 2 lines for favourite of each.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_DATA at Part 2: keywords name the side-by-side columns showing favourite counts.

parts.answer_key: Class A favourite = hockey; Class B favourite = soccer.

parts.student_instructions: Compare your Part 1 prediction to the data. Was it right? Why?
parts.visual_layout: Sentence frame with a yes/no answer box and an explanation line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 right-or-wrong layout for two-population worksheet. Sentence frame: 'I predicted ___ . The data showed ___. My prediction was right/wrong because ___.' 4 lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_CHECK at Part 3: keywords name the compare-and-check task.

parts.answer_key: Any valid linkage of prediction to result with reason.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, design ONE survey question to compare two classes.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check two-population comparison with reason. Part 3 transfer: introduces ONE unfamiliar comparison context (e.g., two grade-levels' favourite snacks instead of pet polls). Verifies comparison generalises.
